name: Demon Possession
overview: The Scriptures reveal that demon possession was a real and troubling condition affecting individuals in the time of Jesus and the early church, as seen in accounts of people possessed by devils or unclean spirits (Matthew 4:24; 8:28; Acts 16:16). Jesus demonstrated His authority over these evil forces by healing and delivering those afflicted, and He empowered His disciples to cast out unclean spirits and heal diseases (Matthew 10:1). The geographical settings of these encounters, such as the regions of the Gadarenes and Gergesenes, emphasize the tangible reality of demonic influence in the world Jesus came to redeem (Mark 5:1; Luke 8:26).
